purpose: Investigate a bounded non-winning result without generalizing its failure or assuming that extra training fixes it.

stages.name: diagnose
actions: retain original fixed test partition for comparability, but label its reuse exploratory if its scores informed redesign
reserve genuinely uninspected test records or fresh external data for confirmatory evaluation of a redesigned method
measure training versus validation error and gradient/circuit diagnostics
quantify information lost to compression with same-feature classical controls

stages.name: prespecify
actions: fix datasets, split/group/time rules, primary metric and acceptance threshold
declare separate original replay and modified-method experiment
freeze optimization, depth, encoding-scale and readout budgets for all models
select settings only inside training/validation; match budget policy

stages.name: run
actions: save all candidates, curves, failed seeds, warnings and compute costs
include regularized full-feature and same-feature classical models
if curves still improve at the budget boundary, report budget-limited rather than impossible

stages.name: evaluate
actions: evaluate the frozen finalist on untouched test data once
report paired uncertainty at the independent experimental unit
retain a no-gain result with its exact configuration
a success on changed data/training is a new result, not a replacement for the old one

stop_conditions: increasing only the quantum compute budget without disclosure
claiming lost input features can be restored merely by training longer
calling absence of significance proof of equivalence
